# Cellwright

> Local Excel VBA inventory and deterministic migration candidates for LibreOffice Basic and Python. Windows and Linux. No external model or API key required.

## Public guides
- [Excel VBA to LibreOffice](https://cellwright.scottcampbell.io/guides/excel-vba-to-libreoffice/): first migration, checklist and scoped verification.
- [UserForms and ActiveX](https://cellwright.scottcampbell.io/guides/userforms-and-activex/): supported controls and manual work.

## Documentation
- [Overview and downloads](https://cellwright.scottcampbell.io/): capabilities, setup and limits.
- [Migration guide](https://github.com/scottcampbelldata/Cellwright/blob/main/docs/migration.md): supported targets, form/control limits and explicit verification.
- [Manual recipes](https://github.com/scottcampbelldata/Cellwright/blob/main/docs/recipes.md): range operations, UserForms and ActiveX migration examples.
- [Validation](https://github.com/scottcampbelldata/Cellwright/blob/main/docs/validation.md): actual checks and unverified behavior.
- [Source](https://github.com/scottcampbelldata/Cellwright): public repository, EUPL-1.2.

## Limits
Conversion produces candidates, not proven equivalents. Scanning and conversion never run macros. Verification requires explicit startup and per-case execution consent. Complex/custom controls, dynamic forms and lifecycle events require manual work. Unknown coverage remains unknown. Effort estimates are uncalibrated. The website does not accept workbook uploads.
